I know you’re scared (I know you're scared)

darlin.songTitle: You Never Even Called Me By My Name
darlin.line: But you don't have to call me darlin', darlin'
stanza: Well, it was all that I could do to keep from cryin'
Sometimes it seemed so useless to remain
But you don't have to call me darlin', darlin'

Let me prove / be worthy of your love
I'll find a way to earn your love
Then you will turn your love
Let me put my lips to somethin'
Let me wrap my teeth around the world
I wanna smell the dinner cookin'
I wanna feel the edges start to burn
